intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Polish president turns back over court raid
items.text: Riot police were deployed outside Poland's Constitutional Tribunal on Friday after police entered the building. The Tribunal's president, Bogdan Święczkowski, was suspended, and Justice Minister Waldemar Żurek asked for his immunity to be lifted. President Karol Nawrocki turned his plane around while flying to Senegal. He wrote on X that the president must be in Poland at a moment like this. The Tribunal called the move a coup d'état.

gloss.riot police: officers trained and equipped to control violent crowds
gloss.suspend: to stop someone from doing their job for a time
gloss.turn around: to go back in the direction you came from
gloss.coup d'état: a sudden, illegal takeover of power

items.title: Italy hit by nationwide general strike
items.text: Thousands of people took to the streets across Italy on Friday during a nationwide general strike. Protesters said they were angry about rising living costs and higher spending on defence. Clashes broke out between demonstrators and police near the Colosseum in Rome. Euronews reported that the country was on high alert as the protests spread.

gloss.general strike: a strike by workers in many different industries at the same time
gloss.break out: to start suddenly, usually something bad like a fight
gloss.on high alert: ready for possible danger or trouble
gloss.living costs: the money people need to pay for housing, food and bills
gloss.demonstrator: a person who takes part in a public protest

items.title: Healey's first Budget raises tax on savings
items.text: Chancellor John Healey has delivered his first Budget since Andy Burnham became prime minister. He said he would raise tax rates on income from property and savings by two percentage points from April 2027. Twenty million households will get a £100 energy payment this winter, and the £12,000 cash ISA limit for under-65s has been scrapped. Healey also said the defence budget was £14 billion higher this year. Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the Budget did not come close to meeting the mood.

gloss.chancellor: the UK minister in charge of the government's money
gloss.percentage point: one unit on a percentage scale, for example from 20% to 22%
gloss.household: all the people living together in one home
gloss.come close to: to almost reach or match something

items.title: Fleetwood knock Arsenal out of League Cup
items.text: Fourth-tier Fleetwood Town beat Premier League leaders Arsenal 5-3 on penalties after a 1-1 draw. Aaron Loupalo-Bi scored first for Fleetwood, and Viktor Gyokeres equalised four minutes into the second half. Arsenal's 16-year-old Max Dowman was sent off near the end after an altercation with Harrison Neal. It was his second red card this month. Fleetwood goalkeeper Ryan Lynch saved a penalty from Bruno Guimaraes, and Conor Haughey scored the winner.

gloss.equalise: to score a goal that makes the score level
gloss.sent off: told to leave the pitch by the referee for a serious foul
gloss.altercation: a short, angry argument or fight
gloss.penalty shoot-out: a way to decide a match by taking penalty kicks one after another
gloss.quarter-final: a match in the last eight of a competition

items.title: Zverev set for No. 1 as Paris draw is made
items.text: The draw for the Paris Masters was made on Friday. Alexander Zverev, who reached the semi-finals in Vienna this week, is set to become world number one on Monday. He and Novak Djokovic could meet in the quarter-finals. Djokovic, a seven-time champion in Paris, opens against Valentin Vacherot, who beat him in Shanghai last year. Carlos Alcaraz is the second seed. Jannik Sinner is out for the rest of the season.

gloss.draw: the random selection that decides who plays whom in a tournament
gloss.seed: a top player placed in the draw so the best players meet later
gloss.semi-final: a match in the last four of a competition
gloss.open against: to play your first match against someone
gloss.quarter-final: a match in the last eight of a competition

items.title: Nvidia chief sees Kazakhstan as AI hub
items.text: Nvidia boss Jensen Huang has visited Kazakhstan for the first time. He said the country could become an artificial intelligence hub for Europe. Euronews reported his comments on Friday. It was his first trip to the country, and the report focused on his view of Kazakhstan's future role in AI.

gloss.hub: a place that is the centre of an activity
gloss.chipmaker: a company that makes computer chips
gloss.artificial intelligence: computer systems that can do tasks that normally need human thinking
gloss.CEO: chief executive officer, the top manager of a company

items.title: Study warns wind turbines kill many bats
items.text: A new study has warned that a shocking number of bats are killed by wind turbines every year. Euronews reported the findings on Saturday, saying the problem is growing as more clean energy is built. Bats can be hurt when they fly close to the moving blades.

gloss.wind turbine: a tall machine with large blades that makes electricity from wind
gloss.clean energy: power that does not produce much pollution
gloss.blade: the long flat part of a turbine that turns
gloss.protect: to keep something safe from harm

items.title: South Park shows new GTA 6 gameplay
items.text: New footage from Grand Theft Auto VI appeared in the latest episode of South Park. Fans noticed that the TV presenter in the episode was voiced by Tish Hicks, who also voiced the GTA 5 gameplay trailer. Push Square reported the story on Thursday, alongside a gallery of about twelve new screenshots of the game. The game comes out on PlayStation 5 on 19 November 2026.

gloss.episode: one programme in a TV series
gloss.presenter: a person who introduces and talks on a TV programme
gloss.gallery: a collection of pictures shown together
gloss.come out: to be released or become available

items.title: UK debt passes £3 trillion as inflation rises
items.text: UK government debt has passed £3 trillion for the first time, and servicing it takes about 8% of public spending. Inflation has risen to a near one-year high of 3.5%, and the Bank of England is expected to raise interest rates soon. Chancellor John Healey said he wanted to give families and businesses some breathing space from the cost of living. Banks are expected to pay a higher surcharge on their profits.

gloss.inflation: the rate at which prices rise over time
gloss.interest rate: the extra money charged for borrowing money
gloss.cost of living: the amount of money people need for basic things like food and housing
gloss.surcharge: an extra tax or payment on top of the usual one
gloss.breathing space: a short period of relief from pressure

items.title: Rockstar says GTA VI is ready
items.text: Rob Nelson, a development lead at Rockstar North, has said that Grand Theft Auto VI is ready. In an interview in Edge magazine, he said it will soon stop belonging only to its developers. Edge also published new screenshots of gang members, a biker group, the main characters Lucia and Jason, and a hammerhead shark. The game is due out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November 2026. No PC version has been announced.

gloss.development lead: the person in charge of making a game
gloss.cover story: the main article featured on a magazine's front page
gloss.screenshot: a picture taken of what is shown on a screen
gloss.gang: a group of criminals who work together
